name: Original generic tandem attack helicopter
rights: Original project-authored geometry and texture; no external asset license dependencies. No manufacturer markings, insignia or branded model identity.
pipeline: Blender 4.5 CPU authoring/export; glTF Transform 4.5.0 dedup/weld/reorder/resample/PNG lossless. No geometry compression decoder.
texture: Original deterministic 512px olive paint PNG, modeled panel seams, localized vertex-color service-panel/exhaust variation; all PBR materials baked to glTF parameters.
axes: Metres, +Y up, +Z forward, X lateral; fuselage-centered root

animation.name: RotorLoop
animation.nativeMixerTest: Both rotor pivots turn, 2 s loop closes, hull transform unchanged

limitations: Rigid display asset only; no weapon gameplay, damage states, cockpit interior, independent sensor/chin-gun aim, rotor motion blur or physics flight model. Ground undercarriage at Y approximately -1.814m relative to fuselage origin. Runtime should loop RotorLoop with AnimationMixer; 1x is 180/480 rpm, 1.5x is 270/720 rpm. Native GPU integration is performed by parent.
